prologue: ^Hello! I am Hudhud. I carry letters.
^This one is from you, five years from now. Most of it is smudged.
^Let's see what kind of week you like.

c-0: ^You open it. Only one line is clear: "Try things. Notice what you enjoy."
c-1: ^You put it in your bag. It feels warm, somehow.
g-0: ^It's Saturday. Your cousin and your best friend both need you.

c-2: ^You open the back of the radio. Two wires are loose. Click. Music!
c-3: ^You explain fractions with slices of roti. Your friend laughs and gets it.

g-1: ^What would you rather do for it?

c-4: ^You draw a bright poster. People stop to look.
c-5: ^You count the money twice. Every rupee is right.

g-2: ^Well done. There are no right or wrong answers here. Each week, the letter gets a little clearer.
